method: Fresh immutable baseline and after binaries; original main-square plans for eligible starts and spacing, R3 paired frame windows for conditional composition. Original and interrupted worlds preserved read only. Starts are eligible candidates, not persisted MCS starts. Complete frame unions include natural terrain, air and water. Biome distribution and terrain are not assumed coordinate-equal. Overworld final samples reuse the completed first-after snapshot: the only subsequent source change is Nether initial height. Nether was freshly regenerated with the final binary.
